// diagnostic

E3303

This no-OS program allocates memory but has no allocator fact.

What

This no-OS program allocates memory but has no allocator fact.

Why

No-OS targets do not provide an implicit system heap.

Fix

Select a typed allocator provider, or use heap-free Core operations.

Worked example
